note: ~25 task-management operations reconstructed from the tables and disagreement cards of the 2026-08-11 misranking investigation. NOT Kestral's live MCP catalog - the report is explicit that its own 18-op reconstruction produced different absolute ranks than the customer's eval, so ABSOLUTE top-k numbers here are not comparable to theirs. Only before/after deltas on this fixture are trustworthy. The RC1 lexical decoys are deliberately preserved: 'Find-or-create', 'Related near-misses', 'relatedTo', 'relatedCandidates', 'Find projects by name' and search_tasks describing itself as 'Semantic search' rather than in the user's words. Removing them would delete the failure this fixture exists to measure. Vectors are DOC-side. Regenerate with: cargo test -p ratel-ai-core --lib regenerate_harness_fixtures -- --ignored

tools.description: Semantic search over the task corpus. Returns tasks ranked by embedding similarity to a natural language query.
Keyword search restricted to tasks assigned to the calling user.
Search tasks and their comment threads together, returning matches from either.
Filter the task list by structured predicates: status, assignee, project, label, due date.
List tasks in a given status column, newest first.
List the calling user's tasks that are not done or cancelled.
List tasks whose blockers are unresolved.
Return the number of tasks matching a filter, without returning the tasks themselves.
Create a new task. Accepts title, body, assignee, project, labels and due date, and will auto-link (relatedTo) any task it detects as a near duplicate.
Create up to 100 new tasks in one call.
Find-or-create a task for a git branch. Related near-misses are reported through related_task_exists rather than creating a duplicate.
Check whether a proposed task already exists. Returns exact duplicates and relatedCandidates (related-but-not-duplicate).
Find tasks linked to a git branch or pull request.
Update the fields of an existing task: title, body, assignee, project, labels, due date or status.
Move a task to a different status column.
Close a task and request review from a named reviewer before it is marked complete.
Link two tasks with a typed relationship: blocks, duplicates, relates to.
Attach a pull request to a task so its merge state is tracked on the task.
Post a progress update onto a task's comment thread.
Add a comment to a task.
Find projects by name or description.
Return the full body of a document by id.
Semantic search across document chunks. Returns the passages that match a natural language query.
Download a document's original file as a binary attachment.
Replace or patch the body of an existing document.
Walk the end of day review: what got done, what slipped, and what is queued for tomorrow.
